args: Plot sizes are stored in square metres as integers.
A member can rent at most 2 plots per season.
Watering-rota emails are sent through Mailgun from src/mail/mailgun.ts.
The growing season opens on the local last-frost date.
Deposits are refunded within 14 days of the plot inspection.
